passages.name: Are you real?

passages.text:
You listen and you can hear the bug crawl.

“Am I still myself?”

The bug pauses. You hear a voice, "Define yourself."

“My name,” you answer.

Your name is yours.

“My body.”

The bug moves closer but keeps distance.

You open your eyes. You take a breath. You exhale slowly.

You look down at your hands.

They are yours.

They have always been negotiating survival.

Your eyes start to feel heavy

[[Close them to rest]]
passages.name: Ask if you are still yourself

passages.text:
The voice from the vent answers, "Justice is paperwork."

What's it to you? Says the bug, says the voice. You aren't sure anymore.

You think. You aren't sure. Is justice one thing?

[[Name it something else]]

You close your eyes.

The bug keeps moving. You can hear it.

You keep your eyes closed.

What kind of closing is this?

passages.text:
You decide not to name it.

Naming makes things permanent.

The bug walks freely now.

You already named me, you hear it say.

Your chest tightens.

“I did not.”

You called me witness.

You lick your finger and press it on a crumb. You bring it over. 

"Here you go."

You are feeling tired.

passages.text:
“Les Misérables Cat,” you announce quietly.

The bug continues walking the perimeter of the cell like it’s inspecting property lines.

“That’s not a cat,” the vent says.

“It survives,” you reply.

The bug stops near a crumb you missed at dinner.

“You think it’s Jean Valjean or Javert?” the voice asks.

You watch the way the bug carries the crumb like it matters.

I am hungry, it says.
That’s all.

passages.text:
“Brutus,” you say.

The bug freezes.

From the vent:

“Bold choice.”

You look up. “You heard that?”

“I hear everything in here.”

The bug moves again. Slow. Deliberate.

“Et tu?” you whisper when it disappears under the cot.

“Something Else.”

Silence

“That’s not a helpful," says the voice from the vent.

“It’s accurate,” you say.

Silence again.

The bug climbs the wall.

You are also something else, you hear the bug say.

You think to yourself me too. 

You watch the bug for awhile and go back to cleaning your milk carton. 

Eventually the bug comes around again.
